'''Todd Theiner''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 DecipherCon IRC 8-Man]] on 6 October 2000 with [[Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|Carbon Chamber Testing]], according to Doug Faust's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1335">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-12-deciphercon-2kd1335/ deciphercon-2k], DeckTech (Doug "Phrim" Faust, 12 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-12-deciphercon-2kd1335/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
